findings.desc: dev-memory-supersession-smoke covers the core projection/display happy path, but it does not cover the full CHK-001..CHK-004 must intent matrix recorded for this story. The smoke seeds one synthetic legacy/current pair where the current entry contains both tags:[supersedes-legacy1] and evidenceRefs:[dev-memory:legacy1] (packages/main/src/tasks/dev-memory-supersession-smoke.ts:51-60), so a regression in either standalone supersession mechanism would still pass even though CHK-002:happy promises both tag and evidenceRef inputs. It also does not exercise CHK-001 happy actual global/project Koala inventory across the recorded legacy ids, CHK-001 edge unmatched legacy readability, CHK-001 adversarial no rewrite/delete of historical evidenceRefs, or CHK-003 happy/edge actual superseding memories for reviewer/delivery/CLI/preflight lessons. The assertions at packages/main/src/tasks/dev-memory-supersession-smoke.ts:82-129 do cover search/preflight ordering, visible superseded/supersedes annotations, legacy readability for a matched superseded row, non_authoritative/gateEvidence=false fixture fields, and one Proofbound/Lattice mapping, but the missing cases mean the smoke is not sufficient coverage for the stated CHK-001..CHK-004 happy/edge/adversarial verification intents.
findings.resolvedReason: Expanded dev-memory-supersession-smoke from narrow single-pair fixture to a 16-check matrix covering tag-only supersession, evidenceRef-only supersession, five known legacy Koala ids, unmatched legacy readability, no rewrite/delete of historical evidenceRefs/content, search/preflight ordering, non-authoritative invariants, and actual committed B-a9e7 project memory entries. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build and node packages/main/dist/tasks/dev-memory-supersession-smoke.js.

findings.desc: Verified blocker: current project/global dev-memory retrieval does not consistently rank current Proofbound/Lattice superseding entries ahead of old Koala entries, despite docs/requirements/decisions/dev-memory.md:68 and :73 requiring search/preflight to surface current guidance first. Repro: `lattice dev_memory_search --query="koala cli" --global --limit=10 --json` returns old global Koala entry 2de5d6b before current project entry 148297b, and `lattice dev_memory_preflight --query="koala cli" --maxEntries=10 --json` does the same. `lattice dev_memory_search --query="koala reviewer" --global --limit=10 --json` also puts old a6832a1/c948c85 ahead of current 34e97f9. The new project memories cite/supersede the old ids and remain non-authoritative (.lattice/dev-memory/experience.jsonl:1-5), so historical retention and authority status are fine; the conceptual failure is the live cross-scope ranking/proof. The expanded smoke mostly verifies synthetic fixtures plus actual project entries exist/cite legacy ids (packages/main/src/tasks/dev-memory-supersession-smoke.ts:367-411), leaving the real project+global ranking gap uncovered.
